text:
Hi Jeff,
It's been a minute. Hope you are doing well.
As you'll remember, last November we discussed my interest in transferring from GTB in Bolivia to another Enron position. You were very nice to recommend that I speak with Jeff McMahon at EIM, as my experience would be used more effectively.
So I have been working on some critical matters at GTB, and we have made strong progress on those. So I did speak with Jeff McMahon on Monday, and he is really interested in me joining EIM. So I expect to hear from him soon, but any support would be appreciated.
So I think EIM is really a strong match for my experience. And I think I can make a significant contribution to the work that he is doing to expand markets in Europe.
Regards,
Nasim Khan
